verdicts.proposedText: Not modeled: Icy Quill — the flat DMG it adds to party members' Cryo hits, scaling on the caster's ATK.
rubricRefs: CANNOT model: no element-filtered all-class flat-DMG buff stat exists (Faruzan Lost Wisdom precedent) — flat-DMG stats are attack-class-scoped only
style rule 3 (no self names): 'the caster's ATK' per the keep-the-stat-owner de-naming lesson (cross-character buff)
verdicts.rationale: Icy Quill is Shenhe's signature team buff — it adds flat Cryo DMG to every party member's Cryo hits, scaling on Shenhe's ATK — yet the skill's effects[] is empty, so no buff window renders at all. Comparable ATK/DEF-scaling flat-DMG buffs (Yun Jin's normalFlatDmg, Xilonen, Layla) DO render as buff bars, so a Shenhe player would be misled by a timeline that shows the E cast with no accompanying team buff. It is not cleanly implementable today: the buff scopes to Cryo DMG across all five attack classes, but the only flat-DMG stats are attack-class-scoped (normalFlatDmg/chargeFlatDmg/plungeFlatDmg/skillFlatDmg/burstFlatDmg) with no element filter — authoring those would wrongly add flat DMG to physical and non-Cryo hits (a fundamentally wrong scope, not an acceptable optimistic over-render), exactly the gap the Faruzan Lost Wisdom note documents. Hence a caveat, not an implement.

groundedIn.claim: Icy Quill is granted to all party members
groundedIn.quote: Grants all nearby party members the Icy Quill effect and deals Cryo DMG in different ways based on whether it is pressed or held.

groundedIn.claim: The buff adds flat DMG to party members' Cryo hits
groundedIn.quote: On each Cryo DMG hit from a party member, 1 stack is consumed and flat DMG equal to (skillpp multiplier × Shenhe's current ATK) is added — this is an ATK-scaling buff.

groundedIn.claim: The flat DMG scales on the caster's ATK
groundedIn.quote: When Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts deal Cryo DMG to opponents, the DMG dealt is increased based on Shenhe's current ATK.

groundedIn.claim: The buff is not authored/modeled (effects[] empty)
groundedIn.quote: …this is an ATK-scaling buff. Not modelable as a static value; reviewer to author scaling-buff representation.

rubricRefs: noCaveat: constitution-excluded (damage numbers) + no rendered surface to diverge from — a self-DMG amplification on one E cast
verdicts.rationale: C4 Skyfrost Mantra accrues stacks that, on the next E, are consumed to boost the DMG of that same E cast (5% per stack). It is a pure self-damage amplification of Shenhe's own skill hit — no teammate buff window, no cooldown/timing change, nothing a player plans a rotation around. Damage numbers are constitution-excluded and there is no rendered surface for a self-DMG-boost on a single cast to diverge from, so the timeline cannot mislead here. Default noCaveat.

groundedIn.claim: C4 only increases the DMG of Shenhe's own next skill cast (self-damage amplification)
groundedIn.quote: When Shenhe uses Spring Spirit Summoning, she will consume all stacks of Skyfrost Mantra, increasing the DMG of that Spring Spirit Summoning by 5% for each stack consumed.

groundedIn.claim: It is a dynamic self-buff on the E hit with no static/renderable window
groundedIn.quote: …each adds 5% DMG Bonus to that cast…This is a dynamic self-buff that accrues between casts — not modelable as a static buff entry.
